result.topic_en: Transformation of multi-dimensional Gaussian (theta-type) sums under linear substitutions, computing a recursively defined factor A_ν via continued-fraction-like recursions p^{ν+1}=m p^ν + p^{ν-1} and determining a sign/eighth-root factor ε.

methods.what: Gaussian sum transformation (theta inversion) for quadratic form in paired variables
methods.quote: $\Sigma e^{\frac{2}{\pi}\sum_1^\mu b_\kappa (n_\kappa+u_\kappa)(n_{\kappa+\mu}+u_{\kappa+\mu})} = \frac{\sqrt{\pi}\,\pi^\mu}{\Pi(-b_\kappa)} \Sigma e^{\frac{2}{\pi}\sum_1^\mu \frac{\pi\pi}{b_\kappa} g_\kappa g_{\kappa+\mu} n_\kappa n_{\kappa+\mu} + \frac{2}{\pi}\sum_1^{2\mu} g_\kappa \pi i u_\kappa n_\kappa}$

methods.what: Expression of p^ν as linear combination of p, q

items.english: The expression is independent of ν.
